key_insight: PhysTrace localizes physical inconsistencies in videos by comparing history-conditioned expectations with observations and describing the conflicts.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers interpretable diagnostics for assessing physical consistency in video models used for prediction, planning, and action generation.
method: Generate history-conditioned physical expectations with a multimodal large language model.
Align expectations with observed video windows to localize and explain violations without task-specific training.
Analyze reconstructed videos across diffusion/flow model trajectories for attribute- and noise-dependent patterns.
evidence_signal: On IntPhys2-Timing, which adds violation intervals to IntPhys2, PhysTrace reaches up to 70.7% Hit Rate across physical principles and outperforms compared methods in overall possible–impossible discrimination accuracy on IntPhys2.
watch_item: Reliance on MLLM-generated expectations may introduce errors; the abstract does not establish robustness beyond the evaluated settings.
paper_title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
